headline: Denied three-family conversion at 218 South Lincoln Street; approved variances for 13 townhouses at 26 Titus Avenue, 4-1; denied parking expansion at 58 Myrtle Street.
summary: Fifteen cases were on the agenda, covering variances for homes, businesses, and land. Approved variances include 13 townhouses at 26 Titus Avenue, a chiropractic office at 801 Hanover Street, and an animal boarding use at 800 Gold Street. Denied were a three-family conversion at 218 South Lincoln Street and the parking expansion at 58 Myrtle Street.
decisions: Continued the 200 Allard Drive variance request (ZBA2025-149) to October 8, 2026.
Withdrawn: variance request for a deck and shed at 602 Granite Street (ZBA2026-054).
Granted variances for seasonal Christmas tree sales on Baker Street, Tax Map 735, Lot 19 (ZBA2026-079), 5-0.
Denied the variance to convert the two-family home at 218 South Lincoln Street to a three-family dwelling (ZBA2026-055), 5-0.
Granted variances for 13 townhouses at 26 Titus Avenue (ZBA2026-063), 4-1; Matthew Carnevale, Jr. voted no.
Granted variances for a two-story addition to the garage with an ADU at 50 Delia Drive (ZBA2026-072), 5-0.
Granted a front yard setback variance for a gabled awning at 191 Portsmouth Avenue (ZBA2025-074), 5-0.
Granted variances for an attached accessory dwelling unit at 52 Faith Lane (ZBA2026-075), 5-0.
Granted variances for a chiropractic office, parking, signs, and a mural at 801 Hanover Street (ZBA2026-076), 5-0, with the illuminated sign off by 10:00 pm.
Denied the parking and paving variances at 58 Myrtle Street (ZBA2026-077), 5-0, with conditions to remove pavement and restore grass within 30 days.
Tabled the nine-unit building proposal at 26 Sullivan Street (ZBA2026-078), 5-0; it will be continued to October 8, 2026.
Granted variances for a deck, covered deck, and refuse toter box at 248 Vinton Street (ZBA2026-083), 5-0.
Granted a minimum buildable lot area variance for Lot 48B at 374 Thornton Street (ZBA2026-080), 4-1, on condition that retaining walls visible from Janelle Ave. are screened by vegetation.
Granted variances for seven accessory structures at 975 Cedar Street (ZBA2026-081), 5-0, on condition that encroaching structures are relocated as shown on the plan.
Granted the minimum lot area variance for an animal boarding, daycare, and training use at 800 Gold Street (ZBA2026-082), 5-0.
Accepted with amendment the minutes of August 13, 2026, 5-0.
